brief.title: Self-service returns portal
business_goals: Reduce agent time spent on returns
Enable customers to self-service returns from their order history without contacting support

stakeholders.name: Meera Nair
concerns: Agents spend about 40% of their day just creating return labels and answering 'where is my refund'
Customers need to be able to start a return themselves from their order history without contacting us
Return window is 30 days from delivery; anything outside that must be rejected automatically with a clear message, not sent to an agent
Customers should get an email at each step: return approved with the label attached, item received, refund issued
We want this live before the Diwali sale, which means end of October

stakeholders.name: Rahul Desai
concerns: Refunds cannot be issued until the warehouse has scanned the item back in
We had ₹18 lakh in refunds last quarter for items that never arrived
The system has to hold the refund until the warehouse confirms receipt
We need a daily report of refunds issued, pending, and rejected, broken down by reason code, so I can reconcile against the payment gateway
Partial returns: if someone ordered three items and returns one, the refund should be for that item only, including its share of shipping if we charged it

stakeholders.name: Priya Shah
concerns: When the item arrives we scan the barcode on the return label
The scan should update the return status immediately and trigger the refund
Our scanners are Zebra handhelds that post to a REST endpoint — the current inventory system already does this

stakeholders.name: Ankit Verma
concerns: The order history lives in Shopify. Whatever we build has to read orders from the Shopify API — we are not migrating orders
Refunds go through Razorpay, same as today
The portal needs to handle our peak. Diwali week we did 12,000 orders a day; returns run about 8% of orders. Page loads should stay under 2 seconds at that volume

constraints: Return window is 30 days from delivery; anything outside that must be rejected automatically
Refunds cannot be issued until the warehouse has scanned the item back in
Warehouse scanners (Zebra handhelds) post to a REST endpoint for return status updates
Must read order history from Shopify API; no order migration
Refunds must be processed through Razorpay
Portal must handle peak volume (12,000 orders/day, 8% returns) with page loads under 2 seconds
Must be live before end of October (Diwali sale)
Support partial returns, refunding only the returned item and its share of shipping
out_of_scope: SMS notifications (email is the must for this phase)

requirements.statement: The system shall allow customers to initiate a return from their order history without contacting support.
requirements.evidence: We need customers to be able to start a return themselves from their order history without contacting us.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically reject return requests submitted outside the 30-day return window from delivery.
requirements.evidence: Anything outside that must be rejected automatically with a clear message, not sent to an agent.

requirements.statement: The system shall display a clear message to the customer when a return request is automatically rejected due to being outside the return window.
requirements.evidence: Anything outside that must be rejected automatically with a clear message, not sent to an agent.

requirements.statement: The system shall prevent the issuance of a refund until the warehouse has scanned the returned item back into inventory.
requirements.evidence: Refunds cannot be issued until the warehouse has scanned the item back in.

requirements.statement: The system shall generate a daily report of refunds.
requirements.evidence: We also need a daily report of refunds issued, pending, and rejected, broken down by reason code, so I can reconcile against the payment gateway.

requirements.statement: The daily refund report shall include refunds issued, pending, and rejected.
requirements.evidence: We also need a daily report of refunds issued, pending, and rejected, broken down by reason code, so I can reconcile against the payment gateway.

requirements.statement: The daily refund report shall break down refunds by reason code.
requirements.evidence: We also need a daily report of refunds issued, pending, and rejected, broken down by reason code, so I can reconcile against the payment gateway.

requirements.statement: The system shall update the return status immediately upon scanning the barcode on the return label.
requirements.evidence: The scan should update the return status immediately and trigger the refund.

requirements.statement: The system shall trigger the refund process immediately after the return status is updated by the warehouse scan.
requirements.evidence: The scan should update the return status immediately and trigger the refund.

requirements.statement: The system shall accept return status updates via a REST endpoint from Zebra handheld scanners.
requirements.evidence: Our scanners are Zebra handhelds that post to a REST endpoint — the current inventory system already does this.
assumptions: The new system will expose a REST endpoint compatible with the existing Zebra scanner output.

requirements.statement: The system shall send an email to the customer when a return is approved, including the return label as an attachment.
requirements.evidence: Customers should get an email at each step: return approved with the label attached, item received, refund issued.

requirements.statement: The system shall send an email to the customer when the returned item is received by the warehouse.
requirements.evidence: Customers should get an email at each step: return approved with the label attached, item received, refund issued.

requirements.statement: The system shall send an email to the customer when a refund is issued.
requirements.evidence: Customers should get an email at each step: return approved with the label attached, item received, refund issued.

requirements.statement: The system shall use email as the primary channel for customer notifications regarding return status.
requirements.evidence: Ideally SMS too, but email is the must.

requirements.statement: The system shall read order history data from the Shopify API.
requirements.evidence: Whatever we build has to read orders from the Shopify API — we are not migrating orders.

requirements.statement: The system shall process refunds through Razorpay.
requirements.evidence: Refunds go through Razorpay, same as today.

requirements.statement: The customer-facing portal shall load pages within 2 seconds during peak volume.
requirements.evidence: Page loads should stay under 2 seconds at that volume.
assumptions: Peak volume is defined as 960 return requests per day, based on 8% of 12,000 orders/day during Diwali week.

requirements.statement: The system shall be live and operational before the end of October.
requirements.evidence: We want this live before the Diwali sale, which means end of October.

requirements.statement: The system shall not support product exchanges in this phase.
requirements.evidence: Exchanges are out of scope for this phase — refund only.

requirements.statement: The system shall support partial returns, allowing a refund for only the returned item(s) from a multi-item order.
requirements.evidence: If someone ordered three items and returns one, the refund should be for that item only, including its share of shipping if we charged it.

requirements.statement: The system shall calculate the refund amount for a partial return to include the returned item's proportional share of shipping costs, if applicable.
requirements.evidence: If someone ordered three items and returns one, the refund should be for that item only, including its share of shipping if we charged it.

epics.title: Customer Return Initiation
epics.goal: Enable customers to easily start a return for their purchased items online.

epics.title: Warehouse Return Processing
epics.goal: Streamline the process for the warehouse to receive and log returned items.

epics.title: Refund Management
epics.goal: Ensure accurate and timely refunds are processed only for returned items.

epics.title: Customer Return Notifications
epics.goal: Keep customers informed about the status of their return and refund via email.

epics.title: Financial Refund Reporting
epics.goal: Provide comprehensive daily reports for financial reconciliation of all refund activities.

stories.title: View Order History for Returns
stories.i_want: to view my past orders from Shopify
stories.so_that: I can select items for return

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in and have placed orders
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the "My Returns" section
acceptance_criteria.then: I see a list of my past orders, including order ID, date, and items purchased.

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged in but have no past orders
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the "My Returns" section
acceptance_criteria.then: I see a message indicating no past orders are available for return.

stories.title: Initiate Return Request
stories.i_want: to initiate a return for eligible items
stories.so_that: I can send back products I no longer want

acceptance_criteria.given: I am viewing my order history, select an item delivered within the last 30 days, and confirm the return quantity
acceptance_criteria.when: I click "Initiate Return"
acceptance_criteria.then: A return request with status 'pending' is recorded in the system for the selected item(s).

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an existing 'pending' return request for an item from a specific order
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to initiate another return for the same item from the same order
acceptance_criteria.then: The system displays a message stating that a return request already exists for this item and prevents duplicate submission.

stories.title: Validate Return Window
stories.i_want: to be informed if my return request is outside the valid window
stories.so_that: I understand why it cannot proceed

acceptance_criteria.given: I initiate a return for an item delivered 20 days ago
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes my return request
acceptance_criteria.then: The return request is accepted for further processing.

acceptance_criteria.given: I initiate a return for an item delivered 35 days ago
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes my return request
acceptance_criteria.then: The return request is automatically rejected and I see a message stating "Return requests must be submitted within 30 days of delivery."

stories.title: Return Status Update API
stories.i_want: a REST endpoint for return status updates
stories.so_that: Zebra handheld scanners can communicate with the system

acceptance_criteria.given: I have a valid API key and a return ID
acceptance_criteria.when: I send a POST request to `/api/returns/{returnId}/status` with `status: "received"`
acceptance_criteria.then: The system updates the return status to "received" and returns a 200 OK response.

acceptance_criteria.given: I send a POST request to `/api/returns/{returnId}/status` with an invalid return ID
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system returns a 404 Not Found error.

acceptance_criteria.given: I send a POST request to `/api/returns/{returnId}/status` with an invalid API key
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system returns a 401 Unauthorized error.

stories.title: Warehouse Scan Updates Return
stories.i_want: to scan a return label barcode
stories.so_that: the system immediately updates the return status

acceptance_criteria.given: I am using a Zebra handheld scanner and have a return label with a valid barcode
acceptance_criteria.when: I scan the barcode on the return label
acceptance_criteria.then: The return status in the system is immediately updated to "received".

acceptance_criteria.given: I am using a Zebra handheld scanner and scan a barcode that does not correspond to an active return
acceptance_criteria.when: I scan the invalid barcode
acceptance_criteria.then: The scanner displays an error message indicating the return is not found.

stories.title: Prevent Premature Refunds
stories.i_want: to prevent refunds until items are scanned into inventory
stories.so_that: we avoid financial losses from unreturned goods

acceptance_criteria.given: A return request has been approved but the item has not yet been scanned into inventory
acceptance_criteria.when: An attempt is made to issue a refund for that return
acceptance_criteria.then: The refund issuance is blocked, and an alert is logged for manual review.

acceptance_criteria.given: A return request has been approved and the item has been scanned into inventory
acceptance_criteria.when: An attempt is made to issue a refund for that return
acceptance_criteria.then: The refund request is successfully sent to the payment gateway.

stories.title: Calculate Partial Refund Amount
stories.i_want: to calculate the correct refund amount for partial returns
stories.so_that: customers are fairly reimbursed for returned items and proportional shipping

acceptance_criteria.given: A multi-item order with total cost $100 (item A $50, item B $50) and shipping $10
acceptance_criteria.when: Item A is returned and approved for refund
acceptance_criteria.then: The system calculates a refund amount of $55 (item A cost + proportional shipping).

acceptance_criteria.given: A multi-item order with total cost $100 (item A $50, item B $50) and free shipping
acceptance_criteria.when: Item A is returned and approved for refund
acceptance_criteria.then: The system calculates a refund amount of $50 (item A cost only).

acceptance_criteria.given: A single-item order with total cost $50 and shipping $5
acceptance_criteria.when: The item is returned and approved for refund
acceptance_criteria.then: The system calculates a refund amount of $55 (item cost + full shipping).

stories.title: Trigger Refund via Razorpay
stories.i_want: to trigger the refund process via Razorpay after a returned item is scanned

acceptance_criteria.given: A returned item has been scanned into inventory and the refund amount is calculated
acceptance_criteria.when: The system initiates the refund process
acceptance_criteria.then: A refund request is sent to Razorpay with the calculated amount and the Razorpay transaction ID is logged.

acceptance_criteria.given: A returned item has been scanned, but Razorpay is temporarily unavailable
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to initiate the refund process
acceptance_criteria.then: The system retries the refund request up to 3 times and logs a critical error if it fails after all retries.

stories.title: Notify Customer of Return Approval
stories.i_want: to receive an email when my return request is approved
stories.so_that: I have the return label and instructions

acceptance_criteria.given: My return request has been approved
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the approval
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive an email with the subject "Your Return Request Has Been Approved" and a return label attached as a PDF.

acceptance_criteria.given: My return request has been approved, but my email address is invalid
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to send the email
acceptance_criteria.then: The system logs an error for the failed email delivery and marks the notification as pending manual review.

stories.title: Notify Customer of Item Receipt
stories.i_want: to receive an email when my returned item is received by the warehouse

acceptance_criteria.given: My returned item has been scanned into inventory by the warehouse
acceptance_criteria.when: The system detects the status update
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive an email with the subject "Your Returned Item Has Been Received".

acceptance_criteria.given: My returned item has been scanned, but the email service is down
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to send the email
acceptance_criteria.then: The system queues the email for later delivery and logs a warning.

stories.title: Notify Customer of Refund Issuance
stories.i_want: to receive an email when my refund is issued
stories.so_that: I know my money is on its way

acceptance_criteria.given: My refund has been successfully processed via Razorpay
acceptance_criteria.when: The system confirms the refund status
acceptance_criteria.then: I receive an email with the subject "Your Refund Has Been Issued" including the refund amount and expected processing time.

acceptance_criteria.given: My refund has been issued, but the email template is missing
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to send the email
acceptance_criteria.then: The system logs a critical error and notifies an administrator.

stories.title: Generate Daily Refund Report
stories.i_want: to generate a daily report of all refund activities

acceptance_criteria.given: It is the end of the business day
acceptance_criteria.when: The daily refund report generation process runs
acceptance_criteria.then: A report is generated containing all refunds issued, pending, and rejected for the day.

acceptance_criteria.given: A daily refund report is generated
acceptance_criteria.when: I review the report
acceptance_criteria.then: The report displays a breakdown of refunds by reason code (e.g., "damaged", "wrong item", "customer changed mind").

acceptance_criteria.given: A daily refund report is generated
acceptance_criteria.when: I review the report
acceptance_criteria.then: The report shows distinct sections or columns for issued, pending, and rejected refunds with their respective amounts and dates.

issues: The acceptance criteria specify the exact API endpoint path and method, which are implementation details. While often necessary for API stories, it makes the story less negotiable.
reviews.fix_instructions: Rephrase ACs to describe the outcome of a status update request rather than the exact HTTP method and path, e.g., 'When a request to update a return's status to 'received' is received with a valid return ID and API key...'

gaps.description: No explicit security requirements for the customer portal or the backend systems handling sensitive order and refund data.
gaps.suggested_question: What are our security requirements for protecting customer data and financial transactions in the new portal, including data encryption, access controls, and vulnerability management?

gaps.description: No explicit availability targets for the self-service returns portal.
gaps.suggested_question: What are the expected uptime and availability targets for the returns portal, especially given its importance for customer satisfaction and agent workload reduction?

gaps.description: No explicit accessibility requirements for the customer-facing returns portal.
gaps.suggested_question: Are there any accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) we need to adhere to for the customer-facing returns portal to ensure it's usable by all customers?

gaps.description: No data retention policies specified for return requests, customer data, or refund reports.
gaps.suggested_question: What are the data retention requirements for return requests, customer information, and refund reports, considering legal, financial, and operational needs?

gaps.description: Explicit data privacy requirements (e.g., how customer data is handled, stored, and processed in compliance with regulations) are not stated.
gaps.suggested_question: Beyond general security, what specific data privacy regulations or internal policies must the portal comply with regarding the collection, storage, and processing of customer personal data?

gaps.description: The specific 'reason codes' for the daily refund report (R-007) are not defined.
gaps.suggested_question: What are the specific reason codes that should be used for breaking down refunds in the daily report, and who will define or manage these codes?

gaps.description: The method for calculating the 'proportional share of shipping costs, if applicable' for partial returns (R-021) is not specified.
gaps.suggested_question: How should the 'proportional share of shipping costs' be calculated for partial returns (e.g., by item value, weight, or quantity), and under what conditions is it 'applicable'?

gaps.description: No stakeholder representing Legal or Compliance is listed, despite the system handling financial transactions and personal customer data.
gaps.suggested_question: Who from our Legal or Compliance team should be involved to ensure the portal adheres to all relevant data protection, consumer rights, and financial regulations?

gaps.description: No stakeholder representing Marketing is listed, despite the system sending customer-facing emails (R-011, R-012, R-013).
gaps.suggested_question: Who from the Marketing team should review the customer email templates (return approved, item received, refund issued) to ensure brand consistency and tone?

gaps.coverage_note: The backlog provides good coverage for the stated business goals, particularly in enabling customer self-service, preventing fraudulent refunds, and improving financial reporting. Key functional requirements for initiating returns, handling partial refunds, and integrating with Shopify and Razorpay are well-addressed. The project also acknowledges the critical delivery timeline and performance needs. However, there are several non-functional areas, such as security, availability, accessibility, and data retention, that require further definition to ensure the portal is robust, compliant, and truly production-ready. Additionally, some specific details regarding financial calculations and reporting need clarification, and involving Legal/Compliance and Marketing stakeholders would strengthen the project's overall readiness.
